entities.summary: Vikram Singh Barn, better known as Vikkstar123 or simply Vikkstar, is an English YouTuber and DJ. He is a member of the YouTube group the Sidemen. Vikkstar123 was a composers & musicians from Guildford (b. 1995-08-02, Guildford). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
